about.title: About me
about.subtitle: Developer, writer, and lifelong learner
about.bio1: Hi, I'm Sanjar — a Python developer based in Tashkent. My work starts with writing code and ends with shipping systems that solve real problems: Telegram bots, AI assistants, and data-driven backend services.
about.bio2: I'm passionate about explaining complex technical ideas in plain language — in Uzbek, English, and Russian. That's why I built this blog: to share what I learn and organize my own thinking along the way.
about.bio3: My approach is simple: every project should be production-ready, secure, and create real value for the people using it. I love theory, but I love shipping even more.
about.education1Desc: In-depth study of algorithms, data structures, software architecture, and security fundamentals.
about.education2Degree: Independent study in AI & Machine Learning
about.education2Desc: Hands-on work with transformer architectures, MLOps, and model deployment pipelines.
about.goals1: Work on internationally recognized AI and backend projects, including collaborations with companies and universities abroad.
about.goals2: Keep producing high-quality technical education content in Uzbek — helping the next generation of developers get started.
about.goals3: Build deep expertise at the intersection of artificial intelligence and cybersecurity.
